budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-DIE7/LAND 10-18: first hardened view of the S81 p4l lane-tail LANDING dsfd_dvland_276l (ot_s81_land W=276 D=8 KW=6; LANDING-CONTRACT L1-L7): ring of 8 slots written on the lane's forwarded clock ck_f (the slots ARE the capture flops, flop-first), read on the block root ck at slot (rc - K) mod 8 into the registered o (flop-last); k[5:0] = the per-lane identity strap K tied by the die binder; no ready / credit / occupancy (static calendar).  bind9 (claude/s81-die7-1018 3923ae6de, STRICT PASS): 17 inst: last station dsfd_dvrlyh_276_NS 12 / _SN 5 (MX) (host plane hf/ht E 28, seqhost jw/jd/cw E 11-16, xtier tv E 8/9).  Faces: lane i + ck_f on N (from the last relay station), o + ck + fault on S (abutted to the receiving block), rs / k strap on E; one master per width, the die mirrors it (MY / MX) for the opposite lane direction.  Outline 51.84 x 64.8 um: data faces N/S sized from 277 pins at <= 6 pins/um (5.34/um on 51.84 um), depth from the gate-measured synthesized std area 1424 um2 at util ~0.5 (first gate at 47.52 x 54.0: util 66%, DPL-0038).  Two CTS roots (multiple_cts_roots): ck_f (lane domain: i, ring slots, wc, epochs) and ck (core: rs, k, rc / warm / fault / o), related same frequency (one PLL, fixed-phase; the lane phase dL is the die's, checked by the die STA as the landing window MCP -setup E -hold D-1).  Slot write enables stay enable muxes as the RTL (the contract's per-slot ICG note is not adopted: no RTL change under the closed bind9; the Qwen qfd_landh kits do the same).  Recipe 4 flop-first, hold_budget die, M5 cap.

reroute_reason.fix: route.pin_balance + disjoint per-port pin_ranges: every bus bit placed monotonically (bit k at the same offset on in and out faces, ascending), replacing the closed view's PPL chunk-scrambled order on abutted joints (pin_order rule c81a8f458); RTL, outline, pin faces unchanged; plus kit reset_landing ON (COORD HANDOFF 0jz: 2 ck flops on rs, core release +2 edges re-derived in the die calendar, data latency unchanged)
